blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Calvin Oftana returned to PBA duties in a big way on Wednesday, firing 31 points as TNT boosted its Governors’ Cup quarterfinals bid with a 116-92 rout of Terrafirma. His ninth career 30-point game enabled Oftana to pick up where he left off from the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games in which he was one of the few bright spots in Gilas Pilipinas’ failed defense of the gold. “I just did my best,” Oftana said when asked about his reflections from that campaign. Oftana and Gilas missed out on a quarterfinals berth in the Asian Games, eventually placing ninth in what became […]...
